correctness.rationale: Re-ran all proof scripts: vertex enumeration over 96 subpieces (76 infeasible, 6 with exact minima 11/5-17/5 each dual-certified, 14 exceptional with minima 4/5, 6/5, 8/5), brute-force Kunz/atom/formula ground truth on 882 tuples, exhaustive scan to ki<=40 with global min W=2, and integer audits to bound 60. Independently re-verified all six Farkas dual certificates from the model equations, verified the sharp witness <5,6,7> (c=10,g=6,n=4,W=2,Ap={0,6,7,13,14},k=(1,1,2,2)) from scratch without Kunz formulas, directly verified the covering claim (each non-atom residue has a tight witness row) plus W>=2 on all e=3 tuples with ki<=15, and verified every subpiece model has full rank 4 so vertex enumeration is sound. Integer-valued W plus exact LP minima above 1 closes all exceptional pieces except the 4/5 pair, which is closed by verified even parity. DRAFT Sec.1 names the sharp example as <5,6,12>, which is a typo: <5,6,12>=<5,6> has e=2,W=0; the correct sharp witness proved in Sec.6 is <5,6,7>, carried in RESULT.md.

originality.rationale: Fused search (SerpBase/OpenAlex/Crossref/OpenAIRE, all ok, 20 results) plus full-text check of the nearest prior work. The closest results prove only Wilf's inequality W>=0: Bruns-Garcia-Sanchez-O'Neill-Wilburne (Wilf for m<=18, all e=3 semigroups Wilf via type bound, equality cases only for W=0) and Garcia-Garcia et al. (minimal Frobenius/genus algorithms for fixed m,e). Neither states nor implies the uniform gap W>=2 for m=5,e=3 with sharp witness <5,6,7>; raising the bound from 0 to 2 with sharpness is a strictly stronger exact fact. Finite genus-100 verifications and GAP/NumericMonoid tables cover only bounded genus, not this infinite family. No synonymous, dual, database, or broader-theorem coverage found.

value.rationale: TARGET-route complete proof of the admitted target: a uniform sharp lower bound W>=2 (minimum exactly 2) for the natural infinite class m=5,e=3, proved over all Kunz faces with machine-checked certificates and a verified extremal witness <5,6,7>. The class, invariant, and gap were motivated before computation, the value 2 was not known or mechanically implied (prior work gives only W>=0), and a future researcher can directly need this precise minimum and witness. This is a new exact-bound theorem, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.

perplexity_final_check.rationale: Terminal search returned 20 results with 1 base overlap; the only overlap (Bruns fixed-multiplicity) duplicates the base nearest prior and still proves only W>=0. Incremental leads (m=19 extension, Sammartano 2e>=m, archimedean W>=1 for e=3, Kunz slides, GAP manual) were compared literally: the most dangerous, W>=1 for e=3, remains strictly below the claimed sharp minimum 2, and no source states, tabulates, or implies W>=2 for m=5,e=3. Remaining hits are surveys, slides, and tools with no quantitative gap claim. Originality PASS is preserved.
